prompts.title: Recent Form: Wins, Draws, Losses
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 analytic motion-graphics sequence, roughly 8 seconds. Use GoatLab charcoal #101412 background, warm white #edf0e6 for titles and axes, lime #c5ed74 for home team accents, slate #8ca6bf for away team accents. Reserve the lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles; all chart content sits above it. Title in warm white, bold condensed sans, Spanish on-screen label: "FORMA RECIENTE · ÚLTIMOS PARTIDOS". Subtitle small Spanish: "Muestra: {{home.n}} y {{away.n}} partidos" with source note "Fuente: Bzzoiro · muestra reciente". Layout: two horizontal grouped count bar clusters, one per team. Shared zero baseline at left; same count scale for both groups. Home cluster uses {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}}; away cluster uses {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}}. Y-axis label Spanish "Partidos"; bars labelled "Victorias", "Empates", "Derrotas" in Spanish, with team names "Kazajistán" and "Islas Feroe" above each cluster. Entry animation: baseline draws first, then bars grow from zero left to right in staggered order. Main comparison: grouped bars align by outcome category so wins sit against wins, draws against draws, losses against losses. Emphasis: the largest bar pulses in lime or slate, and a small sample tag shows {{home.n}} / {{away.n}} to identify any unequal sample sizes; here both sample sizes are shown explicitly. Transition: a soft wipe from home cluster to away cluster. Camera movement: slow push-in from wide to medium, keeping labels legible. Exit: bars settle, sample and source line hold, then fade to the lower-quarter subtitle zone. No predictive language. Ensure Spanish labels, source and sample annotation remain visible.

Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles. Title Spanish: "HISTORIAL DE CRUCES". Subtitle Spanish: "Total de cruces: {{h2h.total}} · fuente Bzzoiro". Layout: a grouped count bar showing historical wins, draws and losses across the available head-to-head sample. Use {{h2h.homeWins}} for "Kazajistán · victorias en cruces", {{h2h.awayWins}} for "Islas Feroe · victorias en cruces" and {{h2h.draws}} for "Empates en cruces". Y-axis Spanish "Partidos"; shared zero baseline and one count scale. Include total sample annotation {{h2h.total}} attached to the whole chart. Spanish labels: "Cruces previos", "Victorias", "Empates", "Muestra". Keep labels legible and source attached.

Top row "Kazajistán" shows {{home.gf}} "a favor" versus {{home.ga}} "recibidos"; bottom row "Islas Feroe" shows {{away.gf}} "a favor" versus {{away.ga}} "recibidos". Camera movement: slow push from wide chart to medium close on the paired bars. Exit: bars settle, source and sample labels hold, then fade into subtitle-safe lower quarter.
